statement: CoreWeave lists the single-GPU NVIDIA GH200 instance at 6.50 dollars per GPU-hour on demand in its North America region.
why: This is the one row on the page where the listed instance contains exactly one GPU, so the posted hourly rate is genuinely a per-GPU-hour rental price rather than a node price.

impact.mechanism: Published rental rates are a display overlay on cloud GPU pricing; with no prior level or stated change on the page, this is a static level only.

confidence.basis: Vendor list price read off the public pricing page; captured as a secondary-tier web page with no displayed last-updated date.

dispersion: No spot price is listed for this instance and no baseline or prior level is shown, so this is a static level.
